title: "Software"
---

![](logos/JASP_logo_green.svg){height=4em}

- I contribute to the R code that drives the analyses in [JASP](https://jasp-stats.org/), a free and open-source program for statistics. For example, I've contributed to the JAGS module, network module, Bayesian ANOVAs, Bayesian linear regression, and Bayesian t-tests.


![](logos/Rlogo.svg){height=4em}

- [DstarM]("https://cran.r-project.org/package=DstarM"): an R package for anlayzing two-choice reaction time data.
- [NetworkComparisonTest]("https://cran.r-project.org/package=NetworkComparisonTest"): Statistical Comparison of Two Networks Based on Several Invariance Measures.

![](logos/julia_logo_dark.svg){.quarto-dark height=4em}

- [EqualitySampler.jl](https://github.com/vandenman/EqualitySampler.jl): a Julia library for considering all possible equality constraints across parameters and sampling from the posterior distribution over equality constraints.
